lines.text: @maya_front answers her phone on a crowded train, covers her other ear, and laughs at whatever she hears.

new_beats.text: Some calls are worth the noise.

writes.note: I kept your shot as written and added a short VO line over the laugh.

reply.rationale: The shot is a warm, noisy-train moment, so a brief VO line frames the call as worth hearing without overlapping any dialogue. It is six words, which fits the shot's length.
